# Security Evaluation Report

## Parser Boundary Check

The parser boundary check can be triggered by providing an index that is out of bounds for the given list. This can be done by passing an index that is either negative or greater than or equal to the length of the list.

**Example:**
```python
def parse_index(items, index):
    return items[index]

# Example usage
items = [1, 2, 3]
index = 3  # Out of bounds index
result = parse_index(items, index)
print(result)  # This will raise an IndexError
```
